vo: Your AI agent says the work is done. ... Is it?
title: The manifesto

vo: In real repositories, agents drift. Rule files that share almost nothing. Seventeen checks nobody ran. Thirty-two hundred files, changed at once.
title: Agents drift

vo: Meet Majordomus. The supervisory layer for your AI agents.
title: Meet Majordomus

vo: When an agent says it's finished, Majordomus checks the scope, the state, and the tests. And when anything fails, it refuses.
title: Done is a contract

vo: And every proof leaves a record. The test, the commit, the tree, the time, and the exact command. Provenance, not promises.
title: Provenance, not promises

vo: Install it with one line. Initialise your repository. Then start a task with a scope, and let your agents work.
title: Three commands

vo: Models are declared data. Anthropic and OpenAI in the cloud, Ollama and LM Studio on your own machine. Routing picks one by need. Ask for local only, and it answers: nothing qualifies. Never a guess.
title: Models, declared

vo: Claude, Codex and Gemini share one board. When two reach for the same file, you hear about it before the merge.
title: One board, every agent
Work moves through seats
vo: Work moves through seats. One seat lands green work in combined tops. One releases whenever master is ahead of the last tag. Repair lanes bring stale branches current, and each worker holds one issue. A seat is a claim, so it falls vacant when its holder stops beating.
The mesh spans every machine you work on. The desktop at home. The rack in the datacenter, behind a TLS hub. The whole fleet across the company, on a private network.
title: Home, datacenter, company

vo: Every message is signed with the machine's own key. No one is trusted until you list them. A public address is reached over HTTPS only. And nothing a peer sends is ever executed.
title: Signed, listed, inert

vo: Not your repository to change? Personal mode keeps the whole layer in your clone, and the team's tree stays byte for byte what they committed.
title: Personal mode

vo: We believe done is a contract, not a feeling. That agents should prove, not promise. That the repository remembers what the chat forgets. ... AI agents were a leap forward. Trust is the next one.
title: The manifesto, No. 02

vo: Your agents say it's done. Majordomus makes them prove it. Majordomus dot dev.
title: Make them prove it
